VA Loan Class for Real Estate Agents

How to write, win, and close VA offers without the guesswork.

When
Tuesday, October 13, 2026 at 10:00 AM MT
How long
45 minutes, including live Q&A
Where
Live on Zoom
Cost

Save my seat

What this covers

Most agents lose VA business twice: once when a listing agent talks their seller out of a VA offer, and once when their own buyer gets steered away from the benefit. This class fixes both. Small group on purpose, so bring real scenarios.

  • The VA myths listing agents still believe, and how to answer them in one sentence
  • What VA will and will not allow a seller to pay, and how to structure the offer
  • The VA appraisal, minimum property requirements, and how Tidewater actually works
  • Writing a VA offer that competes against cash and conventional
  • How to spot a buyer who is VA-eligible and does not know it

Who it is for

  • Agents who want more military and veteran business
  • Listing agents who keep steering sellers away from VA offers
  • Anyone near a base who has left VA deals on the table
